releases.name: AFK CLI 0.2.32
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* test(loop): pin the run-selection rules that shipping got wrong by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/274
* fix(runtime): count the QA rework budget per cycle, so a retry really retries by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/275
* feat(desktop): open JumpServer assets through the jms CLI by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/277
* fix(runtime): a worktree claim belongs to the attempt that took it by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/278


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/compare/cli-v0.2.31...cli-v0.2.32

releases.name: AFK CLI 0.2.31
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(loop): file every loop run under ~/.afk/loop-runs/<tag>/ by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/270
* docs(execution): record that the hashed area is keyed by absolute path by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/272
* fix(state): keep finished-run detail for a week instead of forever by @easyhaloo in https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/pull/273


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/easyhaloo/afk/compare/cli-v0.2.30...cli-v0.2.31
